name: io.github.kant19801201behax5/phoenix-mcp-server
title: Phoenix Zero — Execution Oracle for L2s
description: Before sending a transaction on an L2: PASS/FAIL for the chosen chain. Free verdict delayed ~60 s, no revert ratio; live verdict via x402.

tools.name: check_safety_free
tools.description: FREE safety check for an L2 (100 calls/IP/day): `safe` true/false plus a `reason` code (`safe` is null only with `warming_up`) for the chosen chain, delayed ~60 s. Live verdict: paid x402 GET /api/v1/safe.

tools.name: preflight_network_health
tools.description: PASS/FAIL for the chosen L2 (chain halt, sequencer stall, latency; latency sampled every ~2 s on 2-3 RPC nodes). Free answer delayed ~60 s, without revert ratio. Live verdict with revert ratio (Base/Arbitrum) via x402 from $0.01 USDC (the 402 offers USDC on Base, Polygon or Arbitrum).
